equations.cylindricalEclipse: te = T * acos(sqrt(r^2 - RE^2) / (r * cos(beta))) / pi, with te = 0 above critical beta
equations.batteryEnergy: Ebatt = Pload * eclipseHours * energyReserveFactor / (maximumDepthOfDischarge * dischargeEfficiency * eolCapacityRetention)

limitations: The 1 kW engineering tile is a ground-only development unit and is intentionally excluded from orbital power, eclipse and radiator equations.
The 10 kW flight requirement is continuous electrical input at the compute-payload interface; total spacecraft load is screened from 12 to 15 kW with 13.5 kW nominal.
Solar, battery and thermal factors are preliminary planning assumptions, not supplier performance data.
Active-PV equivalent area excludes packing, gaps, structure, mechanisms and harness. Gross planform applies only the disclosed packing factor and remains a screening result.
Radiator area is an idealized equivalent-area screen. View factors, sink temperature, coatings, orientation, degradation and one-sided versus two-sided geometry are not modeled.
Mass, physical radiator geometry, deployed span, launch compatibility and high-beta orbit availability remain working assumptions or supplier-validation items.
All results are pre-SRR screening values and require supplier data, coupled analysis and test validation.
